baseline: No saved compensation: S=1,T=0,M=0,A=I,b=0,E=0; identical production VQF and causal rest/motion bias learning in every case

wrist.static_metric: RMS of two non-overlapping 5-second quaternion increments during pre-motion 10-20 s, / duration * 60. Post-motion 190-205 s is recovery and is separate.
wrist.motion_metric: Quaternion mean return difference, 5-22 s versus 185-205 s

long_static.metric: RMS of non-overlapping five-second quaternion increments after the first 15 seconds, normalized to deg/min
long_static.reconstruction: Conservative 20 ms overlap of raw sender-duration F04 means, repeated 400/100 Hz production update cadence. Not reconstructed original gyro noise.
long_static.earth_exclusion_reason: No verified initial geographic heading for this separate older recording; the current user direction confirmation applies only to the new wrist recording.

limitations: One independent device/trajectory; physical final return below 0.5 deg is operator-provided, not an external orientation time series.
Pre-motion static evidence is only 10 seconds (two increments); post-motion filter recovery is excluded from this metric. See the independent long-static comparison for longer support.
Ten missing gyro and two missing fresh acceleration samples occur in post-motion rest at ~179.3 s and retain modeled sender time. Static windows avoid all gaps.
Current calibration is from the external RF-matched snapshot; capture omits a complete calibration and live quaternion/runtime state.
Earth initial direction is supported by the operator confirmation. Magnitude and direction are frozen, without sweep or choosing the best result.
Every case starts a fresh production filter; online initialization/history and temperature-smoother state were not recorded.
Single-addition and full-system marginal changes differ; signed changes need not add and can reflect cancellation.
The installed acceleration transform on this device is identity; toggling it cannot establish the value of a separate nonidentity calibration.
